name: Taste of Infidelity
source:
Justin Blake is a celebrity chef in whose restaurant the elites of society don't hesitate to pay huge fees to eat at. The reason this man was able to succeed at such a young age was because the means always justify the ends for his goals. And now... he wants you, someone else's girlfriend.

[From in-app]
